original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system completes 100 OS warm reboots at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails without device loss, hangs or unexpected platform events.
original_method: Freeze complete inventory and exact OS warm-reboot method with no power removal; preserve baseline logs; control dry cold chamber and measured +5% rails; run 100 supervised reboot cycles with bounded shutdown, POST, OS, service and BMC readiness plus per-cycle inventory/events; maintain alternate access, abort without silent retry, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator maintains dry cold/high-rail conditions, supervises 100 service-impacting warm reboots and restores the platform.
required_inputs: Approved OS warm-reboot command and no-power-removal proof
Alternate console/OOB abort and warm-up/restoration plan
safety_requirements: Preserve logs and never silently retry
Confirm warm reset does not become cold/power cycling
Abort on boot loop, missing device, severe RAS, moisture/electrical/thermal fault
Warm above dew point before opening chamber
agent_execution_scope: May analyze per-cycle readiness, inventory and logs
Must not control environment or initiate sequence without execution approval and must not decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve warm method, deadlines and cold profile
